item.title: Nish Daily — 2026-08-03
item.description: Today’s signal is about the layer around the model: durable scopes, reusable skills, local inference, and interfaces that earn trust one state at a time. The useful pattern is not more autonomy in the abstract; it is autonomy bounded by explicit tools, evidence, and recovery paths.

item.title: Nish Daily — 2026-08-02
item.description: Today’s edition is about the systems around modern software: the harnesses that make agents capable, the sandboxes that keep them contained, the memory and hardware bottlenecks that limit them, and the engineering practices that decide whether any of it survives production.
